content: Similarly, evaluations of commodity market trends frequently deviate into broader topics, such as global policy shifts and the role of technology in dictating pricing and material flows, rather than providing the historical specifics necessary for localized competitive intelligence . The systemic lack of direct historical data necessitates the deployment of sophisticated competitive intelligence tools to infer competitors' throughput capacities and operational strengths.
